xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheCompany: Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company Limited
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NoteForNonApplicabilityOfTheDi: The Company has issued unsecured, rated, listed, subordinated, redeemable, fully-paid, non-cumulative, non-convertible debentures (NCDs) in the nature of ‘Subordinated Debt’ in accordance with the IRDAI (Registration, Capital Structure, Transfer of Shares and Amalgamation of Insurers) Regulations, 2024 aggregating to Rs 25,000 lakhs at a coupon rate of 8.15% per annum. The said NCDs were allotted on March 13, 2026, and are redeemable at the end of 10 years from the date of allotment with a call option with the Company to redeem the NCD post the completion of 5 years from the date of allotment and every year thereafter.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. Net Premium Income is Net of Reinsurance
2. Income from Investments (Net) - Policyholders' is Net of Amortization and losses (including capital gains). For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, income is lower compared to the quarter ended 30th June 2026 and the quarter ended 30th September 2025 respectively. This decrease is attributable to the Mark to Market (MTM) impact on investments in equity markets within Unit Linked Funds
3. Transfer of funds from Shareholders' A/c and Transfer of funds to Policyholders' A/c Includes contribution of funds from shareholders accounts towards excess EOM and remuneration of MD/CEOs/WTD/Other KMPs
4. Benefits Paid (Net) is Inclusive of interim and other bonuses and net of reinsurance
5. Expenses other than those related to insurance business is Inclusive of Corporate Social Responsibility expenditure, Interest on Subordinate debt and Penalties (if any)
6. Dividend per share is Interim and Final dividend recommended for respective financial year
7. Advertisement and publicity expenses have been included in other operating expenses for the the current period.
8. Interim Bonus includes Terminal Bonus.
9. Profit carried to Balance Sheet Represents Accumulated Profit
10. Analytical ratios have been calculated as per definition given in IRDAI Analytical ratios disclosure
11. Company has provided 100% provision on CPs and NCDs of IL&FS and IL&FS financial services Ltd, due to default in repayment obligations due to downgrade of rating to Default (D) category. Hence, Net NPA amount would become zero.

During the period ended September 30, 2026, the Company received Rs. 285 Lakhs as interim distribution from IL&FS Financial Services Ltd, resulting in a reduction of the NPA provision from Rs. 8,610 Lakhs to Rs. 8,325 Lakhs in the Shareholder Fund. Additionally, the Company received Rs. 120 Lakhs as interim distribution from IL&FS Financial Services Ltd, leading to a reduction of the NPA provision from Rs. 3,237 Lakhs to Rs. 3,117 Lakhs in the Unit Linked Fund.
12. NPA: Profit/Loss on Derivative amount (TRAD & AnnuityR Fund) is being considered as "Unrealised Gain/Loss" and is included while computing the "Yield with Unrealised Gain and realised"
13. Persistency ratio (Regular Premium/ Limited Premium Payment under Individual Category):
13.1 Persistency ratios are calculated in accordance with IRDAI (Actuarial, Finance and Investment Functions of Insurers) Regulations, 2024 and the Master circular issued thereafter. Persistency ratios include individual business only, Group business policies have been excluded from the persistency calculation.
13.2 Persistency ratios for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 have been calculated on September 30, 2026 for the policies issued in June to August period of the relevant years. For example, the 13th month persistency for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 is calculated for policies issued from June 1, 2025 to August 31, 2025.
13.3 Persistency ratios for the year ended September 30, 2026 have been calculated on September 30, 2026 for the policies issued in September to August period of the relevant years. For example, the 13th month persistency for year ended September 30, 2026 is calculated for policies issued from September 1, 2024 to August 31, 2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnSegmentLiab: 1. Segment Policy Liabilities include funds for future appropriations.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesToBalanceShee:
Notes:
1. The Company does not have any subsidiaries/ associates/ joint venture companies, therefore, consolidated financial statements are not applicable to the Company.

2. The above unaudited financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in Accounting Standard 25 "Interim Financial Reporting" ("AS 25") prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, the relevant provision prescribed by IRDAI (Actuarial, Finance and Investment Functions of Insurers) Regulations, 2024, requirements of Regulation 33 and Regulation 52 read with Regulation 63(2) of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended from time to time, to the extent applicable and IRDAI circular IRDA/F&I/REG/CIR/208/10/2016 dated October 25, 2016 on publication of financial results for life insurance companies.

3. The financial results of the Company for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026 were reviewed by the Audit Committee and subsequently approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on October 09, 2026.

4. The above financial results have been reviewed by the joint Statutory Auditors of the Company, M. Bhaskara Rao & Co. (Firm Registration No. 000459S) and Brahmayya & Co. (Firm Registration No. 000513S).

5. The amounts for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 are balancing amount between the amount as per financial statements for the six months ended September 30, 2026 and the amount as per financial statements for quarter ended June 30, 2026. The same also applies for the amount for the quarter ended September 30, 2025.

6. In view of seasonality of industry, the results of interim period are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected of any other interim periods or for the full year.

7. IRDAI, vide IRDAI (Actuarial, Finance and Investment Functions of Insurers) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026 (“Amended Regulation”) has mandated insurance companies to prepare financial statements in accordance with applicable Indian Accounting Standard (Ind AS) w.e.f. April 1, 2026. The Amended Regulation provides an option to the insurance companies to obtain a forbearance for a period of one year with prior approval of IRDAI. Pursuant to the above, the Company has obtained approval from IRDAI for such forbearance, permitting it to defer the adoption of Ind AS by one year. Accordingly, the Company has prepared its financial statements as per the accounting principles generally accepted in India (Indian GAAP) and Schedule II of the IRDAI (Actuarial, Finance and Investment Functions of Insurers) Regulations, 2024. The joint Auditors have included a emphasis paragraph on this matter in their review report.

8. In accordance with the requirements of IRDAI circular on 'Public Disclosures by Insurers' dated September 30, 2021, the Company will publish the financials on the Company's website latest by October 24, 2026.

9. Figures of the previous period have been re-grouped wherever necessary, to conform to the current year presentation.


Cash Flow Notes:
1. Payments for premiums and claims, annuities and other policy benefits includes Payments to the re-insurers, net of commissions and claims, Payments to co-insurers, net of claims recovery and Payments of claims.
2. Other cash payments from operating activities includes Payments of commission and brokerage, Payments of other operating expenses (Includes amount paid towards Corporate Social Responsibility expenditure), Preliminary and pre-operative expenses, Deposits, advances and staff loans and Goods and Service Tax (GST) paid.
3. Other inflows (outflows) of cash in Cash flows from used in investing activities includes Purchase of Investments, Loans against policies, Loan Disbursed (Loan to ESOP Trust), Sale of Investments and Investments in money market instruments and in liquid mutual funds (Net) (includes movement in net current assets).
4. Interest received includes Interests and Dividends received.


Related Party Transactions Notes:
1. The Company has entered into Forward Rate Agreement (Fixed Income Derivative instruments) with The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited towards which the outstanding notional principal as on 30th September 2026 is Rs 6,045 Lakhs (As on 30th September 2025 – Rs. 25,767 Lakhs) and Margin payable on the same as on 30th September 2026 is Rs 443 Lakhs (Margin receivable As on 30th September 2025 – Rs. 776 Lakhs. The Company has also earned an interest income of Rs 16.43 Lakhs on these margins during the period ended 30th September 2026 (As on 30th September 2025 – Rs. 8.34 Lakhs).
2. IPO related expenses recovered from the Shareholders. Since these expense are borne by shareholders therefore omnibus approval was not taken.

* The Company may also from time to time receive interest from investments issued by these related parties, in line with the terms of investments so made.
